s: Birkat zimmun bishlosha o baasara, ubo z' seipim: kebar nitbaer besiman qs"z shebbirkat hannehenin enah doma lebirkat hammitzvot sheechad motzi chabero bebirkato, abal bebirkat hannehenin mi shennehena hu mebarek beatzmo al hanaato, veen chabero potero ella im ken niqbeu yachad bedabar sheqqebiut moelet bo, sheddarko bekak, sheqqebiutam metzaraptam lihyot nechshabim kegup echad, uberaka achat lekullam. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bibraka rishona, sheddatam lehitchabber veliqboa atzman leekol yachad, abal bibraka acharona, kevan shekkebar akelu vehem mitpordim zeh mizzeh — enan mitztorpin zeh im zeh lehechasheb kegup echad sheyyippateru bibraka achat mehem, ella im ken hem mishshelosha ulemala, sheyyesh shebach veqillus yoter keshemmitztorpin libraka achat, lepi shehem reuyim lezammen, kelomar lehizdammen yachad letzerup beraka bilshon rabbim. Veomer echad mehem: "nebarek sheakalnu mishshello", vehashshenayim omerim: "baruk sheakalnu mishshello ubetubo chayinu". Veim hem shelosha belo hambarek, yakol lomar: "bareku sheakalnu mishshello", kevan shehem reuyim lebarek bilshon rabbim bilado. Umikkol maqom, yoter tob lomar: "nebarek", shello lehotzi atzmo mikkelal hambarekim. Veap al pi sheamar "nebarek", tzarik hu lachazor ulehaknis atzmo liklal hambarekim, ligmor velachazor velomar acharehem: "baruk sheakalnu mishshello ubetubo chayinu", veachar kak matchil: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam veku'". Umi sheomer gam barishona "ubetubo chayinu" — en mochin oto:

Yesh nohagin lehosip "baruk hu ubaruk shemo" qodem shemmatchilin "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam hazzan veku'", vehu tosepet al birkat hazzimmun. Abal keshemmebarek beyachid en maqom leomro (vegam bezimmun omero hamzammen lebaddo velo hamsubbin). (Vegam keshehamzammen omer: "baruk atta Hashem eloqenu melek haolam ku'", en lahem lomar "baruk hu ubaruk shemo", ella yishtequ veyishmeu, kemo shennitbaer besiman qk"d, o yomru immo milla bemilla, kemo shennitbaer besiman qp"g). Veyesh omerim, sheachar shechazar hambarek "baruk sheakalnu" yaanu hamsubbin "amen" acharayv, ki bekan nishlema birkat hazzimmun. Veyesh omerim, shello ameru laanot achar "baruk sheakalnu" ella beechad min hashshuq shenniknas etzel chabura kesheonin "baruk sheakalnu" vehu shomea min hamsubbin, velo achar "baruk sheakalnu" shel hambarek. Veken keshebba etzlam beshaa sheomer hambarek "nebarek sheakalnu" — en tzarik laanot achar "baruk sheakalnu" shel hamsubbin, ella day bemah sheoneh "baruk umeborak" achar "nebarek" shel hambarek, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qtz"ch. Veap al pi shehashshomea beraka achat b' peamim chayyab laanot b' peamim, mikkol maqom, kevan she"baruk sheakalnu" hi aniyya al "nebarek", vehu ana kebar achar "nebarek" mah sherauy lo laanot — shub en tzarik laanot achar aniyyatam, ap al pi shello ana kaaniyyatam, vegam enah aniyya gemura al amirat hambarek, shehu omer "nebarek sheakalnu", vezeh eno oneh "baruk sheakalnu", kol shekken shehamsubbin sheanu "baruk sheakalnu", sheenam tzerikim lachazor velaanot achar hambarek, shechozer veoneh kaaniyyatam. Veken hamminhag. Uledibre hakkol, hambarek eno oneh "amen" achar "baruk sheakalnu" shel hamsubbin, kevan shechozer lomar bepiv acharehem miyyad mah sheameru hem. (Veken haddin bekol zeh baaniyyat "bareku" bebet hakkeneset):

Im hem asara — chayyabim lehazkir hashshem bebirkat hazzimmun, shehambarek omer: "nebarek elohenu sheakalnu mishshello", vehem onin acharayv: "baruk elohenu sheakalnu mishshello ubetubo chayinu". Veen lomar "nebarek lelohenu", ki lo matzinu bammiqra lame"d ella etzel shir vehodaa, kemo "shiru laHashem", "hodu laHashem", abal bibraka neemar: "bemaqhelot bareku elohim vego'", "bareku ammim elohenu vego'", verabbim kemotam, kullam belo lame"d. Umeasara ulemala, apillu hem elep o ribbo — kak hem mebarekim:

Kol hamshanneh mizzeh hannussach, kegon sheomer: "nebarek al hammazon sheakalnu mishshello", o sheomer: "nebarek lemi sheakalnu mishshello" — hare zeh bur, shekkesheomer "nebarek al hammazon", nireh kimbarek lammazon, ukesheomer "lemi sheakalnu", mashma shemmerubbim hem, zeh zan et zeh, vezeh et zeh, ulepi debarayv mebarek et baal habbayit, mah sheen ken "sheakalnu mishshello" setam, mashma shehu yechidi shehakkol okelim mishshello. Umah sheomerim bahaggada "lemi sheasa laabotenu velanu et kol hannissim haellu", zehu lepi shebbenissim i epshar litot sheoseh nissim zulati haqqadosh baruk hu, mah sheen ken bibraka epshar litot shemmebarek et baal habbayit. Ukeshehem asara, kevan shemmazkirin et hashshem en maqom litot shemmebarekin hammazon, veyakol lomar: "nebarek elohenu al hammazon sheakalnu", abal lo "lemi sheakalnu", ki lo yihyeh perush lidbarayv kelal. Veap im yomar: "mi sheakalnu", hare zeh burut, ki mah siman tzarik latet:

Veken haomer bimqom "ubetubo chayinu" — "umittubo chayinu", o "ubetubo chayyim" — hare zeh bur, she"mittubo" mashma dabar muat, umemaet betagmulayv shel maqom. Umah sheomerim: "sabbeenu mittubeka", zehu bishela, shehashshoel shoel dabar muat, keani bappetach sheeno merim rosh lishol sheela gedola. "Ubetubo chayyim", mashma shear haolam chayyim velo hu, umotzi atzmo min hakkelal:

Im taa hamzammen baasara vehaonim velo hizkiru et hashshem bebirkat hazzimmun — enam yekolim lachazor ulezammen beshem, kevan shekkebar yatzeu yede chobat zimmun, ella shebbittelu mitzvat hazkarat hashshem, umeuvvat shello yukal litqon hu. Abal im adayin lo anu acharayv, kevan shello nitqayyema adayin mitzvat zimmun — yachazor hambarek vizammen beshem, veachar kak yaanu acharayv:

Bazzohar hizhiru lomar bepiv qodem birkat hammazon: "ten lanu hakkos unebarek", o "bou unebarek", lepi shekkol dabar shebbiqdushsha tzarik hazmana bappeh ober laasiyyato, kede lehamshik haqqedushsha ulehaabir mah shekkenegdah. Umizzeh nohagim lomar bilshon ashkenaz (rabbotay mi"r vevali"n benteshi"n), vehem onin: "yehi shem Hashem meborak meatta vead olam":
